summary: Journal Check in Business Central finance: a setting in General Ledger Setup that adds a Journal Check fact box to journal pages, showing consistency issues in real time, in total and for the selected line. Demoed on the General Journals page.
overview:
The video shows how to get real-time guidance on journal consistency in Business Central. The Journal Check option is turned on in General Ledger Setup with the Enable Data Check setting.

Once enabled, a Journal Check fact box appears on the right side of journal pages. It shows that there is an issue and gives the total issues. When a specific line is selected, it also lists any issues with that line, so problems can be seen while entering data.
key_points: Enable the feature with the Enable Data Check setting in General Ledger Setup.
After enabling, a Journal Check fact box appears on the right side of journal pages such as General Journals.
The fact box shows the total number of issues in the journal.
Selecting a line shows issues specific to that line, for example a missing amount.
Journal Check gives real-time guidance as you type, as an alternative to the preview posting or test report actions.
